card.name: Prepositions before them or us
card.fires_on: A preposition or verb (around, with, to, for) right before an expected object pronoun like them or us. Often after phrases such as 'the world around', 'carry X with', 'all around'.

modes.label: around before pronoun
modes.description: The word around after 'world', 'all' or 'happening', where them or us comes next.
modes.example: They want to know everything about the world<< around>> them.

modes.label: with/to/for before them
modes.description: A short preposition after a verb or object, followed by them.
modes.example: Instruct patients to carry epinephrine<< with>> them at all times during PALYNZ

card.writes: It favors a following 'them' or 'I' and disfavors 'me', pushing toward third-person or plural pronouns.
card.plain: It fires on small words like 'around' or 'with' when the next word should be 'them' or 'us', not 'me'.
